summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that director Sheldon Trainor-DeGirolamo notified the board on October 1, 2026 of his resignation as a director and from all board committee positions, effective October 15, 2026. The filing states the resignation was not due to any disagreement with the company on operations, policies or practices. No replacement, committee reassignment, advisor or transaction terms were disclosed. The board's size and committee composition will shift mid-October; watch for follow-on disclosure of a successor director and any governance or strategic implications.
